1. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method of providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising the steps of: (a) providing a search engine interface to a user's computer system for searching documents on one or more websites; (b) receiving a search query from the user's computer system via said interface; (c) sending a request based on said search query to a computerised system of a contact center __in response to a user action indicating intent to contact the contact center__; (d) receiving, in response to said request, data enabling a contact center link to be provided to said user, wherein said contact center link, when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center __selected based on analysis of said search query and said request__; and (e) returning said contact center link to said user as part of a response to said search query __wherein said contact center link is dynamically generated and includes routing information specific to said user's search query__.

2. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, further comprising the steps of conducting a search within said documents on one or more websites in response to said search query __using specialized search algorithms configured to identify contact center-relevant content__, and returning at least one document link to one of said documents as part of said response to said search query.

3. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 2, further comprising the step of formatting said response to said search query to display a first result set including said document link and a second result set including said contact center link __wherein the second result set is prioritized based on relevance to said search query and contact center availability__.

4. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) enable a plurality of contact center links to be provided to said user __each corresponding to different contact center resources or departments selected based on said search query analysis__.

5. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) comprise said contact center link.

6. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) comprise an identifier of a link cached by the search engine __and further comprise routing parameters specific to the contact center resource selected in response to said search query__.

7. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link is generated uniquely for said user __based on said search query and user profile information__, whereby activation of the link initiates an interactive communications session recognisable by the contact center as relating to said request from said search engine __and enables the contact center to provide context-aware assistance__.

8. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said request sent to said contact center includes an identifier of said user __and contextual information derived from said search query__, whereby a subsequent interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center arising from initiation of said contact center link enables the contact center to associate said interactive communications session with said request from the search engine __and to provide assistance tailored to the user's search context__.

9. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 8, wherein said identifier of said user is a network address of said user __and said contextual information includes keywords and intent data from said search query__.

10. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a predetermined agent of the contact center __having skills matching requirements identified from said search query__ selected in response to said request.

11. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a predetermined queue of agents of the contact center __configured to handle inquiries related to the topic of said search query__ selected in response to said request.

12. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said link is configured to initiate a communications session from a compatible communications application, if such application is available on said user's computer.

13. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is a voice or video telephony application.

14. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is an instant messaging (IM) application.

15. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is integrated with a browser employed by the user to access the search engine interface.

16. (New) [Claim 16 is withdrawn due to misnumbering in the original application.]

17. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link contains parameters representing customer requirements __derived from analysis of said search query__ which are passed to said contact center within an interactive communications session initiated on activation of said contact center link.

18. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said parameters are indicative of one or more skillset parameters employed by a management system of said contact center __and are determined based on said search query analysis__, whereby said communications session may be directly assigned to a skillset based on the parameters.

19. (Cancelled)

20. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented search engine system providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising: (a) a server for providing a search engine interface to a user's computer system for searching documents on one or more websites and receiving a search query from the user's computer system via said interface; (b) an interface for providing communication with a computerised system of a contact center __configured to transmit requests triggered by user intent to contact the contact center__; (c) a request generator for formulating a request based on said search query __and user context information__ for sending to said computerised system of a contact center; (d) a results generator for providing to said user a contact center link based on data received in response to said request, said contact center link being configured such that, when activated, it enables an interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center __selected and routed based on said search query analysis and contact center availability__.

21. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method of providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising the steps of: (a) receiving from a search engine a request based on a search query submitted to the search engine by a user's computer system __wherein said request includes search context and user intent information__; (b) determining, from said request, the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on stored rules __that correlate search query characteristics to contact center resources and skillsets__; (c) sending to the search engine, in response to said request, data enabling a contact center link to be provided to said user, whereby said contact center link, when activated, will initiate an interactive communications session between the user and said selected resource of the contact center __with routing parameters embedded in said link__; (d) receiving, from said user, a communications session initiation from which said selected resource may be identified __and from which the search context may be retrieved__; and (e) directing said communications session to said selected resource __with context information enabling the resource to provide informed assistance__.

22. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprise an address of said selected resource __and routing parameters derived from said search query__, whereby activation of the link enables the user to initiate a communications session directly with said resource.

23. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprises an identification, for inclusion in a contact center link to be returned to the user, of one or more skillset parameters employed by a management system of said contact center __determined based on analysis of said search query__, whereby said communications session may be directly assigned to a skillset based on the parameters.

24. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprises a unique identifier, for inclusion in a contact center link to be returned to the user, said unique identifier being assigned to said request received from said search engine __and encoding search context information__, whereby a later communications session may be associated with said request based on said unique identifier being communicated within said communications session.

25. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, further comprising the step, carried out after having received a communications session initiation from the user, of amending the stored rules __to improve future correlation between search query characteristics and contact center resource selection__.

26. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 25, wherein the amendment of the stored rules confirms an association between the request received from the search engine __and its search context__ and the resource identified in a contact center link activated by the user.

27. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 25, wherein the amendment of the stored rules confirms an association between the request received from the search engine __and its search context__ and a resource of the contact center which is different from that specified in a contact center link activated by the user but to which the user's communications session is ultimately directed.

28. (Cancelled)

29. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented contact center system for providing users with access to a resource of a contact center system, comprising (a) an interface for receiving from a search engine a request based on a search query submitted to the search engine by a user's computer system __including search context and user intent information__ and for returning data to the search engine in response to the request; (b) a storage area storing rules for determining, from the request, the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on stored rules __that correlate search query characteristics to contact center resources and skillsets__; and (c) processing means programmed to determine the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on the stored rules and to generate data enabling a contact center link to be provided to the user, whereby the contact center link, when activated, will initiate an interactive communications session between the user and the selected resource of the contact center __with routing parameters and context information embedded in said link__; wherein the processor is operably connected to the interface to receive the request therefrom and to provide the data thereto.
